chunks.text: Neurons communicate using action potentials, which are rapid changes in membrane voltage that propagate along the axon.
Definition: A synapse is a junction where a presynaptic neuron transmits a signal to a postsynaptic cell, often using neurotransmitters.
Glutamate is the primary excitatory neurotransmitter in the central nervous system, while GABA is the primary inhibitory neurotransmitter.
Example: When a neuron receives enough excitatory input to reach threshold, voltage-gated sodium channels open and an action potential is generated.
The hippocampus plays an important role in forming new episodic memories and in spatial navigation.
Definition: Synaptic plasticity refers to activity-dependent changes in synaptic strength, such as long-term potentiation (LTP) and long-term depression (LTD).
Support: Myelination increases conduction speed by enabling saltatory conduction between nodes of Ranvier along myelinated axons.
Navigation: In the next section, we will compare electrical synapses (gap junctions) and chemical synapses.
